name: Disruptive Tune

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius Sphere make Constitution saves. Failure immediately breaks Concentration and gives Disadvantage on saves to maintain Concentration for this spell’s duration.
